description.7.0: Specify value for the shape-quality 0 ≤ f ≤ 1 for the unstructured mesher. The default value is 0.7. This parameter controls the trade-off between shape optimization and size optimization. It is the weight of the shape quality in the measure of the global quality of a zone. The default value (0.7) gives a slight preference to the shape quality over the size quality.
